v1.3.0c (2 August 2022) |feed_title = NUCLEAR UPDATE |previous_update = [[v1.2.5]] |next_update = [[v1.3.1|End of Summer Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.3.0''' is the fortieth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 29th of July 2022. This update was also given the name '''Polluted Wasteland II Update''', as it added the [[Polluted Wasteland II]] map. This version encompassed four updates, the main v1.3.0 update (released 29 July 2022), and three minor updates, the v1.3.0a update (released 30 July 2022), v1.3.0b (released 1 August 2022) and v1.3.0c (released 2 August 2022). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== :Multiple enemies were added as part of [[Polluted Wasteland II]] map. *[[Wastewalker|Mutated]] *[[Wasterunner|Mutated Speedy]] *[[Hazardous|Hazmat]] *[[Super Mutant|Mutated Boss]] *[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] ([[Polluted Wasteland II]] variant) *[[Skeleton]] *[[Toxic]] *[[Amalgamation]] *[[Fleshling]] *[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)]] *[[Rusher]] *[[Abomination]] *[[Super Slime|Slime]] *[[Goo|Goo]] *[[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] *[[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]] ([[Polluted Wasteland [[Badlands]] and [[Polluted Wasteland II]] maps *[[Nuclear]] modifier *[[Mutation]] modifier *[[Enemies Beta]] modifier *[[Scared Debuff]] *[[Backrooms]] *Match rejoining ==Removals== *[[MEGA Wasteland II]]. **New enemies it spawns: [[Wastewalker|Mutated]], [[Wasterunner|Mutated Speedy]], [[Hazardous|Hazmat]], [[Super Mutant|Mutated Boss]], [[Toxic]], [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] and [[Rusher]]. *[[Mystery Boss]] now spawns new enemies in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. **New enemies it spawns: [[Super Mutant|Mutated Boss]], [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]], [[Amalgamation]], [[Super Slime|Slime]] and [[Super Toxic]]. *New fan art added to art boards. :In '''v1.3.0a''': *'''Nuclear Monster''' can now only spawn one [[Abomination]], three [[Amalgamation]]s
